bot.welcome_body: Manage your local AI Coding Harnesses (Antigravity, Claude Code, OpenCode, DeepSeek, Aider) directly from Telegram with multi-conversation topics, execution controls, and team collaboration. • Run telegram-harness-manager pair on your PC to link your machine. • Each Conversation runs in its own dedicated Forum Topic. • Configure Model, Thinking Level, and Agent Permissions per topic or per prompt.
bot.pair_success: ✅ Device Paired Successfully! 💻 Machine: {device_name} 🔑 Owner ID: {user_id} Only you (and the guests you explicitly invite per project) can access your projects.
bot.pair_invalid: ❌ Invalid or expired pairing code. Run telegram-harness-manager pair on your PC to generate a fresh code.
bot.no_devices: ⚠️ You don't have any paired PC yet. Run telegram-harness-manager pair in your terminal and tap the pairing link.
bot.control_center_body: Select a project below to open a new conversation topic, configure default Harness/Model/Thinking/Permissions, or manage invited collaborators.
bot.prompt_queued_owner: ⚡ Task dispatched to {harness} ({model} · Thinking: {thinking} · Mode: {permissions}). You will receive the final output when finished.
bot.prompt_held_for_approval: ✋ Approval Required: Your prompt on {project} has been sent to the project Owner for confirmation.
bot.viewer_denied: ⛔ Read-Only Access (Viewer): You can view outputs, thinking steps, and Git diffs in this project, but you are not allowed to launch prompts.
bot.steps_expandable_header: 🧠 {steps_count} steps · {files_count} files touched (Tap to expand thinking & logs)
bot.interactive_multi_hint: Select one or more options below, then tap Confirm Selection:
bot.interactive_single_hint: Choose an option below or reply to this message with custom instructions:
bot.group_not_owner: ⛔ Access Denied: Only a verified Harness Owner with a paired machine can add and link this bot to a group.
bot.group_setup_ok: ✅ Group Linked & Verified! • Forum Topics: Enabled • Manage Topics Permission: Granted • Default Member Role: 👁️ Viewer (Read-Only) As the Harness Owner, you can promote specific members to Proposer (Manual Approval) or Executor from the Control Center or Mini App.
bot.invite_created: 🔗 Collaborator Invite Link Created 🗂 Project: {project} 🎭 Role: {role} 🔗 Link: {link} Share this link with your collaborator. You can change or revoke their role at any time.
bot.invite_accepted: 🎉 Invite Accepted! You now have {role} access to project {project}.
